title: A Bragg array leaves one two-sided input untouched despite added internal resonators
statement: With identical local reciprocal guided columns W_R,j=g*exp(i*q*j),W_L,j=g*exp(-i*q*j), q=pi makes W_R=W_L. The source-convention odd input phi=(1,-1)/sqrt(2) is in their null space. If full scattering exists in the free-reference convention, S_total*phi=phi and ||(S_total+I)*phi||=2 against the specified relative -I phase target.

requires: Identical local reciprocal guided contacts and Bragg phase in the declared source geometry.
Existing on-shell full scattering, a consistent free-reference input/output basis and specified relative -I target on arbitrary two-sided photons.
provides: With identical local reciprocal guided columns W_R,j=g*exp(i*q*j),W_L,j=g*exp(-i*q*j), q=pi makes W_R=W_L. The source-convention odd input phi=(1,-1)/sqrt(2) is in their null space. If full scattering exists in the free-reference convention, S_total*phi=phi and ||(S_total+I)*phi||=2 against the specified relative -I phase target.
assumptions: One prepared coherent channel is a different operation and can remain viable.
Changing contact geometry/phase or input encoding changes the hypotheses; no universal photonic-device no-go follows.
costs: Adding internal modes alone does not change a null source input; pay a genuine port/geometry/encoding change and its controls.
contract.units: Normalized input and state norm; error2 is against a fixed relative phase/reference, not loss probability.

body: In S=I-2pi*i*Wdagger*R(E)*W, every interaction correction vanishes on a photon input with W*phi=0. Extra internal Hermitian couplings and other bath outputs cannot fix the unchanged input without changing the source columns. A consistently rephased port basis changes the named dark vector but not nullity or the relative -I obstruction. This excludes an arbitrary two-sided controlled-minus-phase operation at the Bragg point, not an encoded even-channel-only operation. At off-Bragg2pi/3 the columns may be independent; for N divisible by3 their inner product vanishes. Neither static modal rank nor spectral positivity supplies full photon-port rank. Source finite-matrix residuals are unacquired diagnostics, not the support for this exact identity.

evidence.quote: The off-Bragg single-band matching is not a gate theorem. I computed the genuine finite-band self-energy of a declared Fano-Anderson array, including its real principal-value matrix and **all 60 unwanted angular output channels**, with two guided propagation columns and a frequency-dependent positive bath spectrum. One-channel coherent input error is calculated from the full normalized final state, not postselected transmitted photons. The model uses phase functions q_g(E)=q0+q'_g(E0)(E−E0), θ_rad(E)=θ0 E/E0; it has NOT acquired the full Maxwell dyadic for a finite-cross-section guide.
